usage: icebath uninstall [-h] [--full | --gui | --data] [--gui-summary] [--yes] [--dry-run]

Remove Icebath Agent from your system. Can keep configs/data for reinstall.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --full         Full uninstall - remove everything including configs and data
  --gui          Uninstall only the desktop Chat GUI, leaving the agent intact
  --data         Remove only the active Icebath home's user data, leaving installed code intact —
                 the one mode that works on Nix / bundled-app / Docker installs
  --gui-summary  Print a JSON summary of installed GUI/agent artifacts and exit (used by the
                 desktop app to gate uninstall options)
  --yes, -y      Skip confirmation prompts
  --dry-run      Print what uninstall would remove without changing anything
